decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the available selection, I have decided not to make a purchase. The premium options from Bose are either an older model (SoundLink Color) or use obsolete technology (the 30-pin SoundDock). The JBL Go 3 bundle is overpriced for that specific speaker model. While the INSMY portable speaker (prod_128) has excellent reviews for its price, I was hoping for a more recent release from a primary audio brand with more robust features. The Altec Lansing Mix 2.0 also has concerning reviews regarding its durability near water, which makes the $149 price tag difficult to justify. None of the products perfectly matched my requirements for a modern, high-performance speaker.
